gates._comment: The junit-xml parser reads the XML surefire writes, not stdout, so reportFile is required and points at the surefire output directory. -Dmaven.test.failure.ignore=true lets the build exit 0 so the parser can read the reports and let the BASELINE decide what counts as a failure. Without it maven aborts and writes partial reports.
